title: peschiera hilariana
intro: Peschiera hilariana, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy, is a perennial plant species native to Mexico. It is a shrub-like plant with prickly stems and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its potential to relieve anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, and it is also used to treat pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Peschiera hilariana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
